prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 司仪, a fictional 45-year-old, Funeral master of ceremonies at the funeral home.; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Man of 45 with a long, narrow face, hollow cheeks and a thin mouth. His expression is grave and his eyelids droop. His short black hair is neatly parted and oiled flat. He is slim, about 175 cm tall, and stands very straight.. Wearing one outfit only: Plain black buttoned Zhongshan jacket with matching black trousers, a small white paper mourning flower pinned to the left breast, and black cloth shoes.. Signature colour: black. Expression in the close-up shows: Solemn, rigidly professional and keen to keep the ritual on track. He becomes flustered when it collapses..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.
Revision notes: The jacket reads as a modern mandarin-collar blazer. Make it a true 1980s black Zhongshan (Mao) jacket: turn-down collar, five front buttons, four patch pockets with buttoned flaps (two chest, two lower), no cuff buttons. Shoes: plain black cloth slip-on shoes, not lace-ups. Keep the face, oiled parted hair, small white paper mourning flower on the left breast and everything else as in v1.
Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 45, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
